about.closing: This is a community effort, still growing. If you notice something missing or wrong, our support team is one message away.
about.intro: South Directory brings together the shops, services, products and local talent of South Lebanon in one place, so southerners can support each other and stay productive no matter the circumstances.
about.pointCommunityBody: Buying, hiring and selling locally keeps money and work inside the community that needs it most.
about.pointLocalBody: Every listing is a real business, seller or professional from South Lebanon's towns and districts.
about.pointReviewBody: Our team checks every business and profile before it goes live, so the directory stays trustworthy.

consent.body: The platform draws your attention to the fact that everything you list, whether goods or services, is your own personal responsibility, and that you must ensure it is accurate and matches how you describe it. The platform verifies only that you are from the South, and does not stand behind the dealing between you and the buyer. Where a legal violation is established, you will be removed from the platform.
